licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by two independent readers, with a judge settling every difference and a sweep for the marks, then a fresh check until clean, and checked against the print again here; every bar of every part adds up. The Italian translation, the notes printed only for it, and the stage directions are left out. The piece ends on the piano's last chord before Tamino's recitative "Die Weisheitslehre dieser Knaben". Each boy has his own line; the print puts the First and Second Boys on one staff and Tamino on the Third Boy's staff (in the treble clef, sounding an octave lower). Playback tempo from the median length of complete recordings (Jacobs 2010 1:14, Norrington 1:24, Christie 1995 1:31, Toscanini 1937 1:33, Haitink 1981 1:48).
